question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled'

question: How many products are currently active?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = 1

question: What is the average list price of products in the Electronics category?
sql: SELECT AVG(p.list_price) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Electronics'

question: How many online orders were placed in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'Online' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' AND status <> 'Cancelled'

question: What was total revenue in 2024?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: Which carrier handled the most shipments?
sql: SELECT carrier FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees have the role Sales Associate?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE role = 'Sales Associate'

question: How many shipments are still in transit?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments WHERE delivered_date IS NULL

question: What is the total refund amount for each return reason?
sql: SELECT reason, SUM(refund_amount) FROM returns GROUP BY reason

question: What was total revenue by customer region in 2025?
sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name

question: What are the top 5 product categories by revenue in 2025?
sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show monthly revenue for 2025, in month order.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
note: month label format may differ (e.g. 1 vs 2025-01); scorer accepts extra columns but not different labels

question: Who are the top 10 customers by total revenue of all time? Give their customer IDs and revenue.
sql: SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average order value for each sales channel?
sql: SELECT o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.channel

question: Which supplier's products generated the most revenue in 2024?
sql: SELECT s.supplier_name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average delivery time in days for each carrier, for delivered shipments?
sql: SELECT carrier, AVG(julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(shipped_date)) FROM shipments WHERE delivered_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY carrier

question: How many customers signed up in each year?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', signup_date) AS yr, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY yr

question: Which physical store had the highest in-store revenue in 2025?
sql: SELECT s.store_name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.channel = 'In-Store' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was gross profit by product category in 2025? Gross profit is revenue minus quantity times unit cost.
sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_name

question: How much money was received through each payment method in 2025?
sql: SELECT method, SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE payment_date >= '2025-01-01' AND payment_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY method

question: What percentage of 2025 revenue came from Enterprise customers?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.segment = 'Enterprise' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: What is the cancellation rate (as a percentage of all orders) for each channel?
sql: SELECT channel, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY channel

question: Which month of 2024 had the most returns?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', return_date) AS month FROM returns WHERE return_date >= '2024-01-01' AND return_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was revenue last quarter?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
note: relative time: data ends 2025-12-31, so last quarter = Q4 2025

question: What is the average number of units per order for each channel?
sql: SELECT o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.channel

question: How many distinct products were sold in 2025 from suppliers in each country?
sql: SELECT s.country, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.country

question: What percentage of order line items were returned in each product category?
sql: SELECT c.category_name, 100.0 * COUNT(r.return_id) / COUNT(oi.order_item_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.category_name

question: For each customer region, show 2024 revenue, 2025 revenue, and the percentage growth from 2024 to 2025.
sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rg.region_name, strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY rg.region_name, yr) SELECT a.region_name, a.rev AS rev_2024, b.rev AS rev_2025, 100.0 * (b.rev - a.rev) / a.rev AS growth_pct FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.region_name = b.region_name AND a.yr = '2024' AND b.yr = '2025'

question: What was the top-selling product by units sold in each category in 2025?
sql: WITH u AS (SELECT p.category_id, p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.category_id, p.product_id, p.product_name), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY units DESC) AS rn FROM u) SELECT c.category_name, ranked.product_name FROM ranked JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = ranked.category_id WHERE rn = 1

question: For each store manager, how many orders did their direct reports handle in 2025? Give the manager's employee ID and the count.
sql: SELECT m.employee_id, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM employees m JOIN employees e ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY m.employee_id

question: How many customers placed orders in 2024 but did not place any order in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01')

question: In one row, show total revenue from order items and total payments collected, for orders placed in 2025.
sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01') AS revenue, (SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01') AS payments
note: fan-out trap: joining order_items and payments before aggregating double counts

question: Show cumulative (running total) revenue by month for 2025.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month) FROM m ORDER BY month

question: What percentage of shipped online orders were shipped on the same day or the day after the order was placed?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.shipped_date) - julianday(o.order_date) <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id

question: Which 3 cities had the most distinct customers buying in-store in 2025?
sql: SELECT s.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.channel = 'In-Store' AND o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

question: In one row, show revenue for Q4 2024 and revenue for Q4 2025.
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) END), SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) END) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'

question: How many inactive products still had sales in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE p.is_active = 0 AND o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: What is the net revenue (revenue minus refunds) by product category for all time?
sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT p.category_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY p.category_id), ref AS (SELECT p.category_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT c.category_name, rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0) FROM rev JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = rev.category_id LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.category_id = rev.category_id

question: Which customer segment has the highest average revenue per customer, counting only customers who ordered?
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.segment, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cu.segment, o.customer_id) SELECT segment FROM c GROUP BY segment ORDER BY AVG(rev) DESC LIMIT 1
